titulo_es.@es: Cuánto, qué tan: -(으)ㄴ지 y 얼마나 ~(으)ㄴ지 모르다
titulo_es.@en: How much, how much:으)지 and 얼마나 ~(으)지 모르다

얼마나 좋은지 몰라요.es: no te imaginas lo bueno que es
얼마나 좋은지 몰라요.en: You can't imagine how good it is.

얼마나 바쁜지 몰라요.es: no te imaginas lo ocupado que está
얼마나 바쁜지 몰라요.en: You can't imagine how busy he is.

얼마나 먹는지 몰라요.en: You can't imagine how much he eats.

먹는지.en: how much he eats, if he eats

얼마나 비싼지 몰라요.es: no te imaginas lo caro que es
얼마나 비싼지 몰라요.en: You can't imagine how expensive it is.

바쁜지.es: si está ocupado, lo ocupado que está
바쁜지.en: if you're busy, how busy you are

texto.@es: **얼마나 + adjetivo + -(으)ㄴ지 모르다** puede enfatizar un grado: **얼마나 좋은지 몰라요** = no te imaginas lo bueno que es. No siempre significa literalmente que alguien no sepa algo.
texto.@en: **얼마나 + adjetivo + -(으)ㄴ지 모르다** can emphasize a degree: **얼마나 좋은지 몰라요** = don't imagine how good it is. It doesn't always literally mean that someone doesn't know anything.

texto.@es: Con verbos se usa **얼마나 + -는지 모르다**: 얼마나 기다리는지 몰라요 = no te imaginas cuánto espera.
texto.@en: With verbs it is used **얼마나 + -는지 모르다**: 얼마나 기다리는지 몰라요 You can't imagine how long he's waiting.

texto.@es: **-(으)ㄴ지** también introduce una pregunta indirecta con adjetivos: 좋은지 알아요? = ¿sabes si está bien? **몰라요** significa «no sé» y **모르겠어요**, según el contexto, «no sé / no estoy seguro»; uno no expresa siempre más certeza que el otro.
texto.@en: **-(으)ㄴ지** also introduces an indirect question with adjectives: 좋은지 알아요♪ Do you know if he's okay? **몰라요** means «no sé» and **모르겠어요**depending on the context, «no sé / no estoy seguro»One does not always express more certainty than the other.

texto.@es: El contexto ayuda a distinguir una pregunta indirecta del uso enfático de **얼마나**.
texto.@en: The context helps to distinguish an indirect question from the emphatic use of **얼마나**.
